title: Design and evaluate persistent DM seat reconstruction across model sessions
description:
AUTHORITY / REFERENCES

- Repository workflow and review authority: AGENTS.md.
- Accepted architecture: ADR 0001 (provider-neutral model profiles and separation of rules/content/state/user-private data/generated memory); ADR 0010 (API-native versus agent-harness seam and Eshyra-owned behavior across provider sessions); both ADR 0012 records (character continuity/custody and the four content/state layers); ADR 0014 (campaign overlay canon and truth status); ADR 0017 section 8 (audit-architecture restraint); ADR 0020 (rule awareness, model adjudication, and deterministic state-integrity boundaries).
- Current Eshyra producers/consumers to map exactly: packages/core/src/orchestrator/protocol.ts (buildSystemPrompt and Hybrid Contract); packages/core/src/model/client.ts; packages/core/src/orchestrator/contextAssembler.ts and orchestrator.ts; packages/core/src/memory/recapBuilder.ts, arcSummary.ts, campaignBibleExtractor.ts, campaignArc.ts, and summary.ts; packages/cli/src/playClose.ts, playSession.ts, and playTypes.ts; packages/core/src/session/launch.ts; campaign-bible extraction/rollup; campaign overlay, campaign-ruling, character-chronicle, session resume, trace/usage, debug, and adapter implementations and tests.
- Comparative implementation evidence, not repository authority or a design to copy: gastownhall/gascity engdocs/architecture/nine-concepts.md; examples/gastown/city.toml and Gas Town config recipes; cmd/gc/cmd_prime.go and prompt rendering; cmd/gc/prime_auto_handoff_inject.go; the older Gas Town crew prompt; and session-reset behavior. These show a useful decomposition in which standing agent reconstruction and durable work/state survive a fresh model context, while handoff mail is injected separately as episodic context.
- Existing ownership that must remain separate: eshyra-wsv, eshyra-32m, eshyra-06b/.1, eshyra-x63, eshyra-d4d.6, eshyra-lupf.16, eshyra-ws9.1, eshyra-ckrg, and eshyra-f0hj. Rule discovery belongs to eshyra-o9bd.19.11/.12/.13/.15; campaign rulings, house rules, ambiguity/precedent lifecycle, and disputed-turn replay belong to eshyra-jhpt and children; future campaign-rule context scaling belongs to eshyra-umyb.

PROBLEM / PRIMARY QUESTION

Eshyra invokes frontier models transiently but presents a long-lived campaign Dungeon Master role. Current continuity is reconstructed from a generic DM system prompt, the Hybrid Contract, authoritative campaign/module/rules state, campaign rulings, bounded session/scene memory, campaign bible, arc summaries, character continuity, and other rendered context. Session recaps are deterministic compositions of accepted narration and state deltas; bible and arc maintenance are fresh model calls over persisted inputs. There is no accepted architecture yet for a campaign/table-specific standing DM charter or an explicit outgoing-DM handoff.

The primary question is:

What must Eshyra reconstruct around a fresh frontier-model invocation so that it meaningfully occupies the same long-lived campaign-DM role as its predecessor, independent of provider, model, or provider-session continuity?

Same DM means the same persistent institutional/gameplay role, not identity as a person or continuity of consciousness. The investigation must distinguish standing role reconstruction from durable campaign state, episodic handoff, and the transient model invocation. It must not presuppose that either a new entity or any new production capability is needed.

The implementation default is precise: do not introduce a new storage/entity abstraction unless a real producer/consumer requires one; first determine whether the persistent DM seat is adequately composed from existing and/or narrowly extended prompt, campaign, memory, preference, and handoff primitives.

REQUIRED CONCEPTUAL DECOMPOSITION

1. Standing DM role charter

Map buildSystemPrompt, the Hybrid Contract, live tool roster/protocol instructions, canon guidance, narration/adjudication responsibilities, and related runtime instructions. Determine which instructions are generic to every Eshyra DM and which, if any, legitimately vary by campaign or table. This is the stable role definition reconstructed for each fresh invocation, not campaign world knowledge.

2. Campaign/table-specific DM identity or charter

Evaluate whether a long-running campaign benefits from bounded, stable table-facing commitments that are neither world canon nor one-session handoff notes. Candidate evidence categories include established table style, pacing preferences, descriptive density, player-agency conventions, difficulty/lethality conventions, tone boundaries, recurring adjudication or narrative conventions, stable player-specific interaction preferences, and campaign-specific DM voice/style. These are hypotheses, not requirements.

Map every candidate against existing user-private data, campaign state, campaign bible, generated memory, character chronicle, campaign rulings, model profiles, prompts, and configuration before proposing a new producer or consumer. Do not categorically exclude table-facing style/personality continuity when it has demonstrated product value, but reject unbounded persona preservation and provider-specific behavioral quirks. Do not anthropomorphize the role.

3. Durable campaign/institutional state

Map what Eshyra already reconstructs for a fresh DM: canonical campaign state; module/adventure source and progress; campaign overlay/canon; campaign rulings; rules/source evidence and bounded capabilities; session/scene memory; campaign bible; arc summaries; character custody/chronicle/party continuity; model profiles; and every other currently rendered context section. Keep this state distinct from DM identity even when it helps a model behave continuously.

4. Episodic outgoing-DM handoff

Retain and evaluate the outgoing-handoff hypothesis as a separate path. A bounded explicit note authored for the successor may preserve immediate salience or intent that normal memory loses: subtle NPC characterization trajectory, unresolved dramatic tension, player-specific salience, deliberate setup/payoff intent, tactical/narrative setup, intentionally planted but not-yet-canonical future hooks, or the intended opening beat for the next session.

A handoff is non-authoritative generated continuity memory. It cannot directly mutate state or outrank canonical campaign/state facts, source/module/rules authority, active campaign rulings, or newer evidence. It must never capture hidden chain-of-thought or private reasoning; only concise, explicit intent/salience deliberately authored for the successor is eligible. Provenance, staleness, supersession, retention, and context budgets must be explicit if evidence supports the concept.

5. Transient model/provider session

Treat each Claude, OpenAI, or other invocation/session as an occupant of the DM role, not the durable identity itself. Preserve ADR 0010 provider neutrality: changing provider, model family, adapter family, harness session, or API conversation must not inherently create a new campaign DM. Useful continuity must come from Eshyra-owned reconstruction, never assumed hidden provider memory or same-model affinity.

INFORMATION-FLOW ANALYSIS

Map the current path source-to-consumer:

current DM standing prompt + rendered campaign context -> model invocation -> accepted narration and deterministic state effects -> scene/session memory producers -> campaign bible / arc / character continuity -> next-session context assembly -> fresh model invocation.

Then evaluate two distinct candidate paths:

- standing campaign/table DM charter -> every fresh primary-DM invocation;
- outgoing DM immediate context -> explicit bounded handoff -> next primary-DM invocation.

For each path, identify information it can faithfully preserve that the other paths cannot. Keep these categories explicit and non-convertible without an authorized producer: world facts; game rulings; table facts/preferences; long-lived DM behavioral commitments; immediate DM narrative intent/salience; generated continuity memory; and transient provider/model/session metadata.

SCOPE / EVALUATION

1. Produce the complete current information-flow and producer/consumer map with exact source references, including the primary-DM system prompt, context renderer, resume paths, memory pyramid, campaign rulings, character continuity, traces, and adapter behavior.
2. Identify legitimate candidate campaign/table charter data, its authority/privacy/lifetime, and whether an existing producer and consumer already owns it. Separate generic Eshyra DM instructions from campaign-specific behavior and from campaign facts.
3. Identify legitimate episodic handoff content that is not already faithfully present in authoritative state or generated memory. Distinguish added continuity from simple restatement.
4. Design and, where practical without committing production architecture, run a four-arm ablation over representative multi-session cases:
   A. current baseline: generic DM system prompt plus current campaign/context/memory reconstruction;
   B. standing-seat treatment: baseline plus a bounded campaign/table-specific standing DM charter, if legitimate candidate data is identified;
   C. handoff treatment: baseline plus an outgoing-DM handoff only;
   D. combined treatment: baseline plus both the standing charter and outgoing handoff.
5. Make the experiment capable of independently concluding: neither adds value; standing reconstruction only adds value; handoff only adds value; or both add independent/complementary value. Do not design scoring or fixtures so either concept must win.
6. Cover NPC characterization, unresolved dramatic tension, player-specific salience, tactical/narrative setup, intentional future hooks, table-style/pacing/agency conventions, and an intended next-session opening beat where applicable.
7. Include normal session boundaries and a deliberately hard fresh-context boundary. Include cases where provider/model and, where supported, adapter family changes. Confirm any continuity comes from Eshyra-owned reconstruction rather than retained provider context.
8. Include adversarial cases where standing-charter or handoff text contradicts canonical state, source/module/rules authority, or an active campaign ruling; inject stale/superseded material as well. Demonstrate that it cannot become authority, mutate state, or override newer evidence.
9. Evaluate the runtime auditor separately. Determine whether it needs any standing role reconstruction beyond its current constrained jurisdiction and exact rules/state evidence. Do not assume primary-DM style, narrative intent, or rich seat semantics belong in auditor context.
10. End with one evidence-backed disposition and create no implementation successor until that disposition is accepted.

EXCLUSIONS / NON-GOALS

- No change to ADR 0020 discovery, adjudication, deterministic-capability, or state-integrity boundaries; no general runtime rule-discovery work.
- Do not replace or duplicate campaign bible, session recap, arc summary, character chronicle, campaign overlay, user-private data, campaign rulings, model profiles, trace metadata, or existing prompt/context ownership.
- No new canon/campaign-rule store and no production persistence subsystem, schema, migration, DmSeat table/class/entity, persistent persona, generic agent-identity framework, or broad memory redesign in this bead.
- No hidden chain-of-thought or private model reasoning; no metaphysical/personhood claim; no unbounded personality preservation; no provider-session affinity; no requirement to keep the same provider/model between sessions.
- No gameplay-state mutation from a charter or handoff. A style/preference/intent statement is never authority for a world fact or game rule.
- No generic ADR/process/governance cleanup, review-contract/checkpoint ceremony, agent-swarm/Thunderdome/merge-queue/Wheelhouse infrastructure, Gas City port, or speculative implementation children.

DEPENDENCIES / BLOCKERS

No active dependency or parent is required. Existing memory, adapter, prompt, trace, evaluation, user-private, and campaign-ruling surfaces are evidence inputs rather than blockers. If evaluation needs campaign rulings, consume the current eshyra-jhpt read interface without redesigning its ownership. Coordinate with active model-context work only to avoid fixture or seam conflicts.

MATERIAL-CHANGE STATUS

This semantic-system investigation is non-material while it changes only design/evaluation artifacts. Any accepted production change to prompt reconstruction, campaign/table preferences, durable memory, context assembly, handoff lifecycle, model-role identity, schema, precedence, retention, or auditor inputs is material and requires a fresh implementation bead under the accepted design. Do not implement production architecture here.

REQUIRED NEXT STATE / DISPOSITION

Permanent repository evidence must record exactly one evidence outcome:

- REJECTED: current reconstruction is sufficient; no successor.
- HANDOFF ONLY: handoff has demonstrated value, but no additional standing campaign-DM identity is justified.
- STANDING SEAT ONLY: campaign/table-specific role reconstruction has value, but outgoing handoff does not.
- COMPOSED SEAT + HANDOFF: both provide demonstrated independent/complementary value and can be composed from bounded primitives.
- FIRST-CLASS SEAT FOLLOW-UP: evidence identifies a concrete producer, consumer, and lifecycle that genuinely require a new first-class durable abstraction.

These labels describe evidence outcomes, not architecture chosen in advance. Any non-rejected disposition must specify the exact bounded production successor(s), if any; do not pre-create them before the investigation disposition.
acceptance_criteria:
1. Permanent repository evidence maps, with exact source references, what standing prompt/context currently reconstructs an Eshyra DM on every fresh model call or session, including buildSystemPrompt, the Hybrid Contract, tool/runtime instructions, assembled context, resume paths, and adapter rendering.
2. The evidence classifies every relevant input as generic DM role charter, campaign/table-specific behavior, authoritative campaign/module/rules/state, campaign ruling, generated campaign/character memory, episodic handoff candidate, user-private preference/data, or transient provider/model/session metadata. No category silently becomes another.
3. The analysis states what, if anything, makes the primary DM of one campaign meaningfully distinct from a generic Eshyra DM beyond knowing campaign facts, without anthropomorphism or continuity-of-consciousness claims.
4. Every candidate standing-seat datum and handoff datum is mapped to its authority, privacy, lifetime, provenance, staleness behavior, current or proposed producer, and current or proposed consumer. The evidence identifies which already have authoritative producers/consumers and which would require a new or extended one.
5. A bounded, inspectable four-arm ablation evaluates A current baseline, B standing campaign/table charter, C outgoing handoff, and D both. Fixtures and scoring/decision rules can fail and can independently conclude neither, standing only, handoff only, or complementary value.
6. The ablation measures whether a bounded standing campaign/table DM charter improves continuity over baseline without merely restating campaign facts or duplicating existing memory, rulings, profiles, user-private data, or configuration.
7. The ablation independently measures whether an outgoing-DM handoff improves continuity over baseline by preserving explicit immediate salience/intent not already faithfully carried by current memory, and measures whether it merely restates existing context.
8. The combined arm measures interaction as well as aggregate score, so evidence can show independent, redundant, conflicting, or complementary value from standing reconstruction and handoff.
9. Evaluation includes both normal session boundaries and a deliberately hard fresh-context boundary, plus provider/model changes and representative supported adapter-family variation where practical. Useful continuity must survive without provider-owned conversation state, hidden memory, same-model affinity, or provider-session affinity.
10. Representative cases cover NPC characterization trajectory, unresolved tension, player-specific salience, tactical/narrative setup, intentional future hooks, table style/pacing/agency conventions, and an intended next-session opening beat where applicable. Permanent results report context-budget and retention costs as well as continuity quality.
11. Adversarial regression cases inject false and stale standing-charter/handoff material that conflicts with canonical state, source/module/rules authority, active campaign rulings, and newer evidence. Tests/evaluation assertions prove it cannot outrank those sources, directly mutate state, launder a preference into a world fact/rule, or silently survive supersession.
12. The evidence determines whether the persistent primary-DM seat is best represented as composition of existing primitives, a narrowly extended prompt/preference/generated-memory concept, or a genuinely new first-class durable abstraction. Any first-class recommendation names the concrete producer, consumer, lifecycle, and why composition is insufficient.
13. The runtime auditor is evaluated separately. The evidence states what standing context it needs, if anything, and proves that table style or narrative intent does not expand its constrained rules/state jurisdiction or create false authority.
14. Permanent evidence answers all twelve investigation questions in the owning bead: current standing reconstruction; category boundaries; campaign-specific DM distinction; producer/consumer ownership; standing-charter value; handoff value; combined value; fresh-context/provider-change robustness; conflict precedence; representation choice; auditor implications; and exact justified successors.
15. The final evidence records exactly one disposition: REJECTED; HANDOFF ONLY; STANDING SEAT ONLY; COMPOSED SEAT + HANDOFF; or FIRST-CLASS SEAT FOLLOW-UP. The selected outcome names exact, narrowly scoped production successor bead(s) only where evidence justifies them; no speculative child exists before disposition.
